'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021 Myanmar coup d'état]]
**[[Tatmadaw|The military]] hands over power to [[Min Aung Hlaing]] and announces a [[state of emergency]] for a year, after detaining [[Aung San Suu Kyi]] and other leaders of the [[National League for Democracy]] party. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-55882489  (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Twelve people are killed when two vessels sink close to a port on [[Colombia]]'s [[Pacific]] coast, in [[Tumaco]]. [https://www.canberratimes.com.au/story/7107240/twelve-dead-in-colombia-after-boats-sink/ (''The Canberra Times'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in British Columbia]]
*****[[British Columbia]] confirms 18 cases of the [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2|new variants]] of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] from the [[United Kingdom]] and [[South Africa]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/covid19-bc-february-1-update-1.5896685 (CBC)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]], [[501.V2 variant]]
*****[[Ontario]] reports its first case of the 501.V2 variant in a person from the [[Regional Municipality of Peel|Peel Region]] with no known travel history. [https://www.cp24.com/news/ontario-s-first-case-of-south-african-variant-of-covid-19-confirmed-in-peel-region-1.5291100 (CP24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****The [[United States]] surpasses 26 million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.marketwatch.com/story/u-s-tops-26-million-covid-cases-as-blizzard-conditions-hamper-vaccinations-in-northeast-11612195045 (''MarketWatch'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Tokyo]] surpasses 100,000 cases of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://mainichi.jp/english/articles/20210201/p2a/00m/0na/007000c (''The Mainichi'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]] 
****[[Pakistan]] receives 500,000 doses of [[Sinopharm]]'s [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.thenews.com.pk/amp/783361-500000-doses-of-china-gifted-sinopharm-covid-19-vaccines-reach-pakistan (''The News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]] 
****[[Vietnam]] closes schools in 22 [[Provinces of Vietnam|province]]s ahead of the [[Tết]] holiday and ends a [[Communist Party of Vietnam|Communist Party]] congress early following the detection of a new cluster of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] cases in northern areas. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/vietnam-shuts-schools-covid-19-outbreak-lunar-new-year-14089004 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]]
****[[Dubai]] closes all bars and pubs for the entire month of February and limit other activities due to rise of COVID-19 cases across the [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/dubai-closes-bars-limits-activities-virus-cases-spike-75614934 (ABC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Armenia]] 
****[[Armenia]] approves the use of the [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] developed by [[Russia]]. [https://en.armradio.am/2021/02/01/armenia-approves-use-of-sputnik-v-vaccine/ (Public Radio of Armenia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Austria]] announces the easing of its [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] from February 8, allowing non-essential shops and schools to reopen while toughening border restrictions and implementing a curfew from 8:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. local time. [https://www.vienna.at/lockdown-oeffnung-diese-regelungen-gelten-ab-dem-8-februar/6883247 (Vienna.at)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Isle of Man]]
****The [[Isle of Man]] lifts its second "circuit-breaker" lockdown after 20 days without a community case. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-isle-of-man-55886263 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] eases its national restrictions by allowing the reopening of bars, restaurants and museums in 16 "Yellow-zone" regions. However, a curfew from 10:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. will remain in place. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20210201-restaurants-and-museums-reopen-as-italy-relaxes-coronavirus-curbs (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Lithuania]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Lithuania]] reports its first case of the UK variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] in a woman from [[Vilnius]] who tested positive for COVID-19 in early January. [https://www.lrt.lt/en/news-in-english/19/1334243/lithuania-confirms-british-variant-of-coronavirus (LRT)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]] 
***[[South Africa]] receives one million doses of the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] produced by the [[Serum Institute of India]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/south-africa-delivery-covid-19-vaccines-75608564 (ABC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2021 Myanmar coup d'état]]
**[[Foreign relations of Myanmar|Myanmar–United Kingdom relations]]
***The [[Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office]] summons the [[List of ambassadors of Myanmar to the United Kingdom|ambassador of Myanmar to the United Kingdom]] in response to the coup. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/uk-summons-myanmar-ambassador-over-military-coup-2361546 (AFP via NDTV)]
**[[Myanmar–United States relations]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] threatens to re-impose sanctions on [[Myanmar]]'s military leaders and calls for them to relinquish the power that they seized in the coup. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-politics-usa-idUSKBN2A1322 (Reuters)]
*[[Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[Andorra]] stops recognizing [[Juan Guaidó]] as the interim [[President of Venezuela]]. [https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/nacional/2021/02/01/andorra_deixa_reconeixer_guaido_com_president_venecuela_174123_1125.html (''Diari d'Andorra'')]
*Cardinal [[Pietro Parolin]], the [[Cardinal Secretary of State|Vatican Secretary of State]], visits [[Cameroon]] this week. He hopes peace and reconciliation can be found in the country, which is struggling amid an armed separatist movement in the Southwest and Northwest regions. [https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/cardinal-parolin-brings-message-of-peace-and-reconciliation-to-cameroon-86689 (Catholic News Agency)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020–2021 Indian farmers' protest]]
**Internet access remained [[Internet censorship in India|blocked]] following violent clashes between police and farmers protesting controversial agricultural reforms. Online access was suspended in at least 14 of 22 districts in [[Haryana]] near [[New Delhi]]. That order was first imposed on [[Republic Day (India)|Republic Day]] in Haryana districts for 24 hours, but has been extended every day since. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/02/01/asia/india-internet-cut-farmers-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2021 Boğaziçi University protests]]
**A total of 159 people are detained at the protests over the appointment of [[Melih Bulu]] as the rector of [[Boğaziçi University]] in [[Istanbul]], [[Turkey]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-security-bogazici-idUSKBN2A13P6 (Reuters)]
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack|Aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol]]
**Over 228 people have been charged or arrested for participating in the [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|storming]] of the [[United States Capitol]]. [https://www.businessinsider.in/most-of-the-arrests-from-the-capitol-riots-have-been-misdemeanor-curfew-violations-this-searchable-table-shows-everyone-charged-so-far-/international/news/most-of-the-arrests-from-the-capitol-riots-have-been-misdemeanor-curfew-violations-this-searchable-table-shows-everyone-charged-so-far-/articleshow/80193894.cms (''Business Insider'')]
*[[2020–2021 United States racial unrest]]
**Protesters marched in [[Rochester, New York]], after a nine-year-old girl was handcuffed and [[pepper-sprayed]] by police. Protesters ripped away barricades protecting a Rochester police precinct as hundreds took to the streets in outrage. [https://www.democratandchronicle.com/story/news/2021/02/02/protest-rochester-ny-after-police-pepper-spray-9-year-old-girl/4345035001/ (''Democrat and Chronicle'')]
*[[2020 Oregon Ballot Measure 110|Ballot Measure 110]] goes into effect in [[Oregon]], making it the first state to decriminalize possession of small amounts of specified [[List of Schedule I drugs (US)|Schedule I]] and [[List of Schedule II drugs (US)|Schedule II]] drugs. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/oregon-1st-state-decriminalize-possession-hard-drugs-75617078 (ABC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 President of the Chamber of Deputies of Brazil election]], [[2021 President of the Federal Senate of Brazil election]]
**The [[National Congress of Brazil]] elects new leaders for the [[56th Legislature of the National Congress|56th Legislature]]. [[Arthur Lira]] and [[Rodrigo Pacheco (politician)|Rodrigo Pacheco]], candidates supported by [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]], are elected [[President of the Chamber of Deputies (Brazil)|President of the Chamber of Deputies]] and [[President of the Federal Senate (Brazil)|President of the Federal Senate]] respectively. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2061199/brazil-congress-elects-new-leaders-in-test-for-bolsonaro (AFP via ''Bangkok Post'')]
